meta.verificationMethod: Loom genSources (Vineflower, 6622 classes) + javap -p -constants on merged named jar

overallVerdict.pureClientFpv: FEASIBLE but split: camera-roll/attitude + direct GLFW RC input are 100% client-side and server-invisible; any client-side translation/thrust change is free in singleplayer, tolerated within vanilla thresholds on own server, rubber-banded on public vanilla, and flagged/banned on prediction anti-cheats.

rubberBandThresholds.multiplierQ: move packets since last server tick, capped at 5, forced to 1 if >5
rubberBandThresholds.condition: p - o > r*q where p=dx^2+dy^2+dz^2 from firstGood, o=server deltaMovement lengthSqr

findings.claim: Elytra start triggered client-side by jump key while airborne
findings.safeApproach: Trigger elytra via vanilla jump; do not force flag locally.

findings.claim: tryToStartFallFlying requires !isFallFlying && canGlide() && !isInWater; startFallFlying sets shared flag 7 (FALL_FLYING) which syncs to server
findings.safeApproach: Do not fake fall-flying; server re-checks canGlide every tick.

findings.claim: canGlide requires !onGround && !isPassenger && no LEVITATION && an elytra item in any EquipmentSlot
findings.safeApproach: Maintain valid elytra; server clears flag if canGlide() false.

findings.claim: Server maintains glide: updateFallFlying runs only when isFallFlying; durability (hurtAndBreak 1 every 10 ticks, alternating) and ELYTRA_GLIDE game event are server-side only; server forces stop if !canGlide()
findings.safeApproach: Client cannot extend glide beyond server canGlide(); it will be reverted.

findings.claim: Firework thrust on gliding wearer: per tick deltaMovement += look*0.1 + (look*1.5 - deltaMovement)*0.5
findings.safeApproach: Use real firework entities; do not fabricate client thrust. Thrust is replicated server-side by the rocket entity.

findings.claim: Glide physics updateFallFlyingMovement: gravity g*(-1+0.75*cos(xRot)^2), lift on descent, up-boost on pitch-up (y*3.2), 0.1 steer toward look, damping (0.99,0.98,0.99); runs on both client and server
findings.safeApproach: Modifying this curve deviates from server physics; only do it in singleplayer.

findings.claim: Client sends its real position + yRot/xRot + onGround/horizontalCollision every tick; no roll/quaternion in packet
findings.safeApproach: Roll never leaves the client; safe to inject freely.

findings.claim: Speed check: r=300 if fall-flying else 100; triggers teleport-back when p-o > r*q; skipped for singleplayer owner, dimension change, or PLAYER_MOVEMENT_CHECK off

evidence.constant: r=300.0F/100.0F; gamerules PLAYER_MOVEMENT_CHECK & ELYTRA_MOVEMENT_CHECK default true

findings.safeApproach: Keep client-side added displacement squared under ~100 (walk)/~300 (elytra) per packet budget; prefer enabling translation only in singleplayer.

findings.claim: Collision check: after server move, residual p>0.0625 (0.25 blocks) and new collision => hard teleport to last good position; otherwise accept client position
findings.safeApproach: Never clip through blocks; residual must stay below 0.25 blocks.

findings.claim: NaN/non-finite coordinates disconnect; horizontal clamp +/-3e7, vertical +/-2e7
findings.safeApproach: Guard RC-derived values against NaN/extreme magnitudes.

findings.claim: Rotation yRot/xRot is wrapped and accepted on the normal path; on speed violation the teleport back carries the server's own rotation
findings.safeApproach: RC-driven yaw/pitch is fine; expect rotation to be corrected together with position on any setback.

findings.claim: Call chain GameRenderer.render -> updateCamera -> Camera.setup(level,entity,detached,mirrored,partialTick); then renderLevel builds view matrix from camera.rotation().conjugate()
findings.safeApproach: Inject roll after Camera.setup, before renderLevel reads rotation.

findings.claim: setRotation builds quaternionYXZ(PI-yRot, -xRot, 0.0F); roll third Euler angle hardcoded 0. forwards/up/left vectors derive from this.rotation
findings.safeApproach: Right-multiply a roll quaternion onto this.rotation via mixin.

findings.claim: FOV/near-plane distance unchanged by roll: near=0.05, up/left scaled by tan(fov/2); projection matrix excludes roll
findings.safeApproach: Roll only rotates the screen; no perspective distortion.

findings.claim: First-person hand/held item uses the same rolled view matrix as the world, so the hand follows the roll (fixed to view)
findings.safeApproach: No extra work; hand naturally stays glued to the rolled view.

findings.claim: Third-person camera clip (getMaxZoom) raycasts along the rolled forwards; fluid/fog near-plane corner sampling follows roll
findings.safeApproach: First-person FPV unaffected; minor fog-edge sampling offset at extreme roll.

findings.claim: Vanilla 1.21.11 has no joystick/gamepad abstraction; InputConstants.Type only KEYSYM/SCANCODE/MOUSE. USB remote must poll LWJGL GLFW joystick API directly.
findings.safeApproach: Call glfwJoystickPresent/glfwGetJoystickAxes/glfwGetGamepadState from the client/render thread.

findings.claim: Hotplug via glfwSetJoystickCallback fires during glfwPollEvents on the main thread; joystick state polling is safe on the render/client thread.
findings.safeApproach: Register callback and poll axes each client tick on the main thread.

findings.claim: Opening a Screen releases mouse and calls KeyMapping.releaseAll(); movement keys read as up while GUI open
findings.safeApproach: Config screen must override isPauseScreen()=false; RC is read directly so it keeps working.

findings.claim: Pause only in singleplayer integrated server when screen.isPauseScreen() and world not LAN-published; pause stops level tick, particles, and ServerboundClientTickEndPacket
findings.safeApproach: Keep config screens non-pausing so flight continues.

findings.claim: Vanilla server trusts client position within speed (100/300) and collision (0.0625) tolerances; no deeper physics re-simulation
findings.safeApproach: Small client translation survives vanilla servers; expect rubber-band beyond thresholds.

findings.claim: Prediction anti-cheats (Grim) replicate elytra physics server-side (PredictionEngineElytra) and flag any deviation; render-layer camera roll is not detectable server-side
findings.risk: high for translation mods, low for camera roll
findings.safeApproach: On Grim-grade servers ship camera-roll/RC-only mode; never alter translation/thrust.
